deployment: Trusted local stdio, UID/GID 10001, read-only root filesystem, --cap-drop ALL, --security-opt no-new-privileges. No privileged operator executes utilities inside the running container. Added packages, root/privileged containers, and remote HTTP require a new assessment.

CVE-2026-76642.reason: The mount post-hook privilege escalation requires a privileged mount operation. The service has no mount capability, no setuid utilities, and cannot acquire new privileges.

CVE-2026-78408.reason: The cgroup descriptor leak requires an operator to run nsenter --join-cgroup as root. The non-root MCP process does not invoke nsenter, and privileged operator execution is outside this deployment.

CVE-2026-78409.reason: The detached mount-tree traversal needs a privileged mount operation. The container has no mount capability, no setuid mount utility, and cannot gain either.

CVE-2026-78410.reason: The bind-mount ownership attack requires setuid/root mount execution. The image strips setuid bits and the deployment removes capabilities and privilege acquisition.

CVE-2026-54369.reason: The pathname ACL attack requires a privileged caller. The service has no elevated identity or capabilities and does not call libacl pathname functions.

CVE-2025-69720.reason: The vulnerable code is in the infocmp executable, which the image removes explicitly. Debian-essential ncurses-bin and its libraries/data remain installed; the probe verifies the affected executable is absent.

CVE-2026-16742.reason: Only the source package's shared libraries are installed. The vulnerable systemd-homed service is absent; no homed-managed users or daemon exist in this image.

CVE-2026-9538.reason: perl-base does not include the affected Archive::Tar module. The runtime probe verifies that module is absent.
